prompt: How do I record a meeting in Teams?
completion:
## How to Record a Microsoft Teams Meeting

Recording a Teams meeting is straightforward, but a few quick checks will make sure you can do it without a hitch.

| **Platform** | **Where to Find the Record Button** | **Typical Permissions Needed** |
|--------------|-------------------------------------|--------------------------------|
| **Desktop (Windows/Mac)** | In the meeting toolbar → “More options (…)” → **Start recording** | You must be the meeting organizer, or your Teams admin must have allowed you to record. |
| **Web** | Same as Desktop: click “More options (…)” in the toolbar → **Start recording** | Same as Desktop. |
| **Mobile (iOS/Android)** | Tap the screen → “More options (…)” → **Start recording** | Same as Desktop; mobile only works if you’re the organizer or have recording rights. |

> ⚠️ **If “Start recording” is greyed out** →  
>  • Your admin has disabled cloud recording for you or the organization.  
>  • The meeting is happening on a channel that hasn’t been set to allow recordings.  
>  • You’re using a guest account that doesn’t have recording rights.

---

### Step‑by‑Step Guide

> **1. Join or start the meeting**  
>  • If you’re starting a meeting, you’ll see the recording controls automatically.  
>  • If you’re joining an existing meeting, wait until the meeting starts.

> **2. Begin recording**  
>  • **Desktop/Web**: Click the three‑dot **More options (…)** button in the meeting toolbar.  
>  • **Mobile**: Tap the screen to show controls, then tap **More options (…)**.  
>  → Select **Start recording**.  
>  • Everyone in the meeting will see a banner that says “Recording is in progress” and a notification will pop up in the chat.

> **3. Pause / Resume (optional)**  
>  • Tap **More options (…)** → **Pause recording** (or **Resume recording**).  
>  • This pauses the audio, video, and screen share for everyone; the banner updates to “Recording paused”.

> **4. Stop recording**  
>  → **More options (…)** → **Stop recording**.  
>  • The recording stops immediately; the banner disappears.

> **5. End the meeting** (optional)  
>  • You can leave the meeting while the recording is still processing. The recording will finish automatically once the meeting ends.

---

### Where Does the Recording Get Stored?

| **Meeting Type** | **Storage Location** | **Who Gets a Link** |
|-------------------|----------------------|---------------------|
| **Channel (Teams) Meeting** | The channel’s **Files → Recordings** folder (SharePoint) | All channel members |
| **Private (One‑to‑One / Group) Meeting** | The organizer’s **OneDrive for Business → Microsoft Teams Chat** folder | The organizer, and anyone who has the link |
| **External (Guest) Meeting** | Same as Private, but the recording will be in the organizer’s OneDrive | The organizer (who can then share the link) |

> 📌 The recording is first stored in **Microsoft Stream (classic)** for legacy accounts. Newer Teams accounts use **OneDrive for Business** or **SharePoint**.

---

### After the Recording Is Done

1. **Processing** – Teams transcribes the meeting and processes the video.  
2. **Notification** – A message appears in the meeting chat saying “Recording is available”.  
3. **Access** – Click the link in the chat to view, download, or share.  
4. **Retention** – Your Teams admin can set policies for how long recordings are kept (e.g., 90 days, indefinite).  

---

### Common Troubleshooting Tips

| **Issue** | **Possible Cause** | **Quick Fix** |
|-----------|-------------------|---------------|
| “Start recording” is disabled | Admin policy, guest account, or not the organizer | Contact your Teams admin; check your role |
| No recording after meeting ends | Recording not started (missed the button), or license issue | Re‑check recording step; confirm you have an active Microsoft 365 license |
| Recording missing from files | Wrong meeting type (e.g., a “Meet Now” call that wasn’t saved) | For “Meet Now”, recordings are saved in the chat instead of a channel |
| Video quality is low | Network bandwidth, camera settings | Use a wired connection or check your camera |

---

### Quick Summary (1‑2 Minutes)

1. **Join** the meeting.  
2. **Click** the three‑dot **More options (…)** → **Start recording**.  
3. Optionally **pause/resume** via the same menu.  
4. **Stop** when you’re done.  
5. Wait for the chat message that the recording is ready, then share or download.

That’s it! 🎬

Feel free to ask if you’d like more detail on any step, or if you’re using a specific Teams version (e.g., Teams for Mac, Teams on Android, or Teams in a particular compliance environment).
